genann.c:86 -> src/genann.rs:105: assert !isnan(a); a < -15 -> lookup[0]; a >= 15 -> lookup[4095]; j = (a+15)*interval+0.5 with j>=4096 clamp; return lookup[j] -- every C statement is present. Forced proposal genann_write is WRONG: genann_write (genann.rs:61) is the serializer writing '%d %d %d %d' + ' %.20e' per weight to a Write sink and returns (), nothing in common with a sigmoid lookup.

Labeled as the correspondence (not STUB) because it is not a signature-only no-op/constant placeholder but a defective translation; reviewer may downgrade to STUB:genann_run.
